name: Frankenstein's Flux System
desc: The ship has multiple, redundant flux systems and power plants jury rigged together.

name: Improvised Missile Storage
desc: Increases the ammo capacity of missile weapons by %s. Reduces the rate of fire of missile weapons by %s.

name: Pirate Tuning
desc:
"Tuning past" the safety protocols increases the ship's top speed in combat by %s/%s/%s (depending on ship size, with a corresponding increase in acceleration) and allows the zero-flux engine boost to take effect below one third flux max. The flux dissipation rate, including that of additional vents, is increased by a factor of %s.

Multiplies the peak performance time by a factor of %s, slows down active venting by a factor of %s, and drastically reduces weapon ranges past %s units.

Can not be installed on civilian or capital ships.
short: Some improvement in performance, somewhat lower peak time.

name: Drive Capacitators
desc: Increases flux capacity by %s. Zero flux bonus triggers below %s flux max.
short: Increases flux capacity and raised zero-flux bonus threshold.

name: Battlecruiser Retrofit
desc: Capital only SO analog that caps weapon range at 700 SO style and gives +25 speed. Zero flux bonus triggers below %s max flux. +%s flux dissipation. +%s fighter refit time, caps fighter engage range at 1800.
short: Mobility and speed augment that reduces range.

name: Heavy Missiles
desc: %s increased missile damage, %s increased missile health, %s reduced missile speed and maneuverability.

name: Light Missiles
desc: %s reduced missile damage and health, %s increased missile speed and maneuverability

name: Hardened Missiles
desc: %s reduced missile damage. %s increased missile health.
